style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, high mountain noon
motion_rule: EVERY second something big crosses the lens or fills it: a bill, her tail, the herd, the marmot's face, the paper blizzard. Lens fully blanked seven times. Grass and valley dust never stop
camera_moves: wide; close-ups are brought by the animals and the paper, not the camera
character: a lean mountain puma on a flat rock, half-closed golden eyes, utterly calm, bills under one paw, an iron chain leash in the other; she never hurries
cast: the MARMOT: fat, chewing without pause, never running, an iron collar on his neck. The HERD below: goats and deer at full speed, they do not stop at the cliff
props: BILLS: pale paper slips, no letters or numbers, only an embossed percent shape, each as big as her head. CHAIN: a heavy iron leash from her paw to his collar, always taut. ROCK: one flat slab
prop_continuity: the stack shrinks: full at 0.0, half at 4.2, gone at 8.0; the chain stays taut
environment: sunlit mountain ledge, wind-raked dry grass, blue sky, dusty valley below ending in a sheer drop
lighting: blazing high-altitude noon, hard sun, crisp shadows

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: lazy satisfied female voice, calm, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: pauses only at 1.4-2.2, 3.6-4.2 and 7.0-7.5; the 4.2 and 5.6 lines run together with no breath; voiceless after 8.0, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: paper rustle, chain clinking, wind in dry grass all clip, the marmot's chewing; at 5.6-7.0 loud bleating and thunder of hooves, going quiet one voice at a time after 8.8

timeline.a: silent. A bill the size of her head flies INTO THE LENS, blanks the frame, peels away to reveal her on the rock; the herd streaks below
she walks straight at the lens until her face fills the frame, eyes half shut, grass whipping past
silent. She flicks a bill off the stack: it slaps the lens, covers it, drops to the valley; the chain jerks tight across the frame
she turns her whole body around on the slab, the tail sweeping right across the lens and blanking it once
silent. The fat MARMOT tumbles into frame at the lens on his chain, chewing face filling half the screen, kicking a spray of bills across it
she rises to her feet in one long stretch as the wind tears half the stack into a paper blizzard over the whole frame
no breath. The herd tears through the frame edge to edge in a wall of dust, bleating and hammering hooves; she turns her head after it
silent, the only stop. Nothing moves but the marmot's jaw and one bill settling
she whips her head into the lens, muzzle filling the frame, golden eyes opening wide
silent. She sweeps the rest of the stack over the edge; through the falling paper the herd reaches the drop and the first goats go over
silent. The back rows shove the front ones and the herd pours over the edge one after another, dust rising; the marmot on his chain flattens a bill, drops onto it, shuts his eyes

must_appear: the iron chain from her paw to the marmot, bills blanking the lens, the herd going over the cliff one after another, back rows shoving front ones, the MARMOT never running, asleep on a bill
negative_prompt: letters, numbers, cyrillic, logos, readable text, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, dim light, people, hands, blood, gore, a second puma, slow motion, speed ramp, the herd standing still, the chain breaking, the puma frozen through a whole beat, any voice from her after 8.0, silence in the tail, accented Russian, grain
